proposed_blocks:
LOD-FLOOR-MAP-REPAIR-001 — AUTHOR NATIVE CORRECTION (2026-10-12)
Require the party’s discovered current-floor map in all modes, including installed developer mode. Ordinary Q/M/VR never grants or reveals other floors. Replace the edge-on paper pickup with a floating globe and an eye facing the viewer from any angle; preserve placement, shared touch ownership and Magic drain. Globe colors/mesh and eye dimensions are IMPLEMENTATION-TUNABLE within existing resource/depth bounds.

LOD-FLOOR-MAP-REPAIR-UI-001 — AUTHOR NATIVE CORRECTION
Q/M/VR on an unfound floor keeps the minimap closed and says “Map not found — find this floor’s map”. Developer mode does not bypass party discovery, filtering or personal Magic admission. Add “Press E to Talk to the Hermit” to the existing central staging interaction prompt, honoring the rebound Use key, talk reach, player role/life/staging state, menus and existing speaker reveal.

LOD-FLOOR-MAP-REPAIR-GATE-001 — PRESENTATION AND FINITE REGRESSION
Use one lazily cached colored sphere mesh (18-unit radius, 16 segments, 8 rings) with a viewer-facing 48×20-unit eye above it. Depth-test it normally; expand render bounds, retain six-cell body cull/two-cell label cull and Reduced Effects. Validate discovery with developer mode both on/off on server, client and Magic; unavailable-floor Q/M/VR notices; cache isolation; globe closed outward geometry/eye facing; one Hermit HUD prompt at existing 112-unit talk reach and rebound keys. Native appearance remains separate.
